_comment: CakePHP 3.x -> 5.x leftover patterns. severity: blocker = fatal/removed in 5.x, warning = deprecated or behaviour change, info = style/typing. phase = which cake5-* skill fixes it. Regexes are PCRE, matched per line.

patterns.fix: TableRegistry::getTableLocator()->get('X') or $this->fetchTable('X') inside controllers/commands (LocatorAwareTrait).
$this->fetchTable('X') (assign to a property if the old code relied on $this->X).
->orderBy([...]). Query::order() was removed in 5.0.
->groupBy([...]).
Named arguments: find('list', keyField: 'id', valueField: 'name'). Options arrays are deprecated in 5.x.
->get($id, contain: [...]).
->enableHydration(false) / ->disableHydration().
Cake\I18n\DateTime / Cake\I18n\Date (immutable). Mutating calls (->modify) now return a new object: reassign the result.
Type-hint Cake\ORM\Query\SelectQuery (or UpdateQuery/DeleteQuery/InsertQuery).
$this->request->getData() / getQuery() / getParam().
Immutable PSR-7 API: $this->response = $this->response->withHeader()/withType()/withStringBody()/withStatus(); request->getHeaderLine()/getCookie().
Cake\Mailer\Mailer (viewBuilder()->setTemplate(), setViewVars(), deliver()).
AuthComponent was removed. Use cakephp/authentication (Authentication component, identity) - see cake5-auth.
Cake\Filesystem was removed in 5.0. Use native PHP / SplFileInfo, or the App\Filesystem\File/Folder shims (cake5-upgrade/references/gotchas.md).
Convert to Cake\Command\Command in src/Command (execute(Arguments $args, ConsoleIo $io): ?int).
Rename .ctp -> .php and move src/Template -> templates/ (Element -> element, Layout -> layout).
protected array $_accessible = [...] (typed properties are required in 5.x).
public function initialize(array $config): void (Tables/Behaviors) / initialize(): void (Controllers/Components).
Type-hint Cake\Event\EventInterface $event.
public function validationDefault(Validator $validator): Validator.
'sortWhitelist' -> 'sortableFields'. Move 'conditions'/'contain' out of $this->paginate into the query passed to paginate($query).
Paginator->counter('Page {{page}} of {{pages}}, ...') takes a format string, not an options array.
Form->create(null, [...]).
Only finder options (keyField/valueField/groupField, contain:, custom finder params) are named args. limit/order/conditions/fields must be chained: ->where()->orderBy()->limit().
find()->where([...])->contain([...])->orderBy([...]) instead of an options array.
SelectQuery is no longer a collection: ->all()->toList() / ->all()->indexBy() / ->all()->extract(). (Single-line heuristic — also review multi-line chains.)

Removed classes compile fine and only fatal when reached (also in catch/instanceof). Laminas\Diactoros; Authentication\PasswordHasher\DefaultPasswordHasher; ErrorTrap/ExceptionTrap + WebExceptionRenderer; Cake\Http\ServerRequest/Response/Session; Cake\Database\TypeFactory.
RequestHandlerComponent was removed. Use $this->request->is('json') and controller content-type negotiation (viewClasses() / addViewClasses()).
here() -> getRequestTarget(); getParam('_csrfToken') -> getAttribute('csrfToken'); env() -> getEnv(); input() -> getBody()/getData().

In 5.x Cake\I18n\Time is a TIME-OF-DAY class: datetimes are Cake\I18n\DateTime. A lone `instanceof Time` meant for datetimes is silently false — use `instanceof \DateTimeInterface`. (Safe if the same condition also checks DateTime/FrozenTime.)
Singular helpers were removed: ->subDay() -> ->subDays(1), ->addMonth() -> ->addMonths(1).

DateTime/Date are immutable: a bare `$d->addDays(1);` is a silent no-op. Reassign: `$d = $d->addDays(1);`. (Check each hit — the statement may be on the right side of an assignment on the previous line.)
$this->addPlugin('Name', [...]) in Application::bootstrap() (CLI-only plugins in bootstrapCli()).
routes.php returns `static function (RouteBuilder $routes) { $routes->scope(...) }`.
CsrfProtectionMiddleware option is 'httponly' (lowercase).
newEntity() requires a data array in 5.x: use ->newEmptyEntity() for a blank entity.
notEmpty()/allowEmpty() were removed: use notEmptyString()/allowEmptyString() (or ...Array/File/Date/Time/DateTime by field type).

Redeclared framework properties must match the parent's type (fatal otherwise): protected array $paginate = [...]; protected array $fixtures = [...]; protected string $layout = '...'. Components/helpers: load them in initialize() instead of $components/$helpers.
PHPUnit 10: protected function setUp(): void / tearDown(): void (and public static function setUpBeforeClass(): void).
Deprecations are hidden, so deprecated APIs survive the upgrade. Use E_ALL while converting; only suppress after the scan is clean.
Form->input() -> Form->control(); 'inline' => false -> 'block' => true.
Route placeholders use braces: '/{controller}/{action}/*' (colon syntax removed in 5.0).
Fixtures no longer define schema; load schema via SchemaLoader/Migrator in tests/bootstrap.php, keep only $records.
IntegrationTestCase was removed: extend Cake\TestSuite\TestCase and `use Cake\TestSuite\IntegrationTestTrait;`.
Connection::connect() was removed (the 3.x skeleton Pages/home.php used it). Replace the template with the 5.x skeleton one, or use $connection->getDriver()->connect().

Cake\I18n\Time is a time-of-day class in 5.x (no date part). The 3.x datetime class is Cake\I18n\DateTime: Time::now() -> DateTime::now(), new Time($s) -> new DateTime($s). Then audit mutations (3.x Time was mutable).
Chronos setters return a new object: `$d->hour(23)->minute(59);` is a silent no-op. Reassign: `$d = $d->hour(23)->minute(59);`.
EntityInterface::errors() was removed in 4.0: ->getErrors() / ->getError($field) / ->setErrors(). (Validator::errors() is a different method — check the receiver.)
LogTrait::log() takes Stringable|string in 5.x (TypeError for arrays): ->log(json_encode($entity->getErrors()), ...).
Multi-line chain ending in a collection method: if the receiver is a query, insert ->all() first (SelectQuery has no toList()/__call in 5.x — fatal).

FormHelper 5.x renders dates as one HTML5 <input type="date|datetime-local"> posting "Y-m-d" — the year/month/day select widgets (and their options) are gone. Controllers reading getData('x.year') / implode('-', getData('x')) and JS reading [name="x[year]"] must be ported.

5.x puts uploads in request data as UploadedFileInterface (no uploadedFilesAsObjects switch): getError(), getClientFilename(), getSize(), moveTo()/getStream()->getMetadata('uri'). Warning only if a shim middleware converts them back to arrays.

Paginator settings no longer apply query options (5.x only warns and DROPS conditions/contain/fields): move them onto the query — $this->paginate($table->find()->where(...)->contain(...)) — keep order/limit/sortableFields in settings. Dropped conditions/contain can silently remove tenant scoping. Multi-line arrays: also grep `$this->paginate =` blocks. (Association options in Table classes also use conditions: — those hits are fine.)

Returning a value from event listeners (beforeFind/beforeSave...) is deprecated since 5.2: modify the query in place and `return;`, or use $event->setResult(). (Check the hit is inside an event callback.)
FormHelper::create('name') has no context provider in 5.x (3.x fell back to a null context): use create(null, [...]).
